publication_policy: No feeding verdict or site publication without species/plant-part scope review.

records.source_title: Desert Tortoises (Gopherus agassizii) Are Selective Herbivores that Track the Flowering Phenology of Their Preferred Food Plants
records.plant_part: succulent herbaceous material; individual species part not established in abstract
records.supports: Wild G. agassizii consumed these listed taxa in field foraging observations; foraging selectivity varied by phenology.
records.does_not_support: Captive feeding safety, dosing, feeding frequency, or transfer to Testudo/other tortoises.

records.source_title: Biogenic Elements and Heavy Metals in Hermann’s Tortoises—Testudo hermanni: Effect on Serum Biochemistry and Oxidative Status Parameters
records.plant_part: grass and herbaceous plants, species-specific part not specified
records.supports: Study methods report captive feed comprised approximately 70% grasses (Lolium perenne and Festuca), 25% herbs (dandelion and plantain), and 5% other plant materials.
records.does_not_support: Optimal diet ratio or proven safety for every named plant species; diet is husbandry description, not feeding trial.

records.source_title: Nutrition and husbandry conditions of Palearctic tortoises (Testudo spp.) in captivity
records.supports: Survey of 1075 respondents describes association between housing/diet pattern and pyramidal growth; >80% grasses and weeds in summer was used as a diet category.
records.does_not_support: Causal proof or individual plant safety; not a species-level feeding observation.

records.source_title: Feeding ecology and seasonal movements of giant tortoises on Aldabra atoll
records.supports: Seasonal field observations found tortoise turf dominated feeding observations; Sporobolus virginicus coastal sward was used by tortoises.
records.does_not_support: Safety of all grasses or universal suitability for other tortoise species.

summary: Four independently retrievable publications, with source-specific limitations. Plant names need canonical taxonomy reconciliation before import.
